verdict.rationale: The evidence shows SigNoz exposing its data to external AI agents (Claude, Cursor, Copilot, Codex) through an official MCP server and published Agent Skills. Nothing documents an AI assistant built into the SigNoz product itself that users can delegate tasks to. Those external-agent integrations are adjacent capabilities and earn no credit for a built-in assistant, and the use-case titles (e.g. 'Dashboard Creation from Natural Language') are not shown to run in an in-product assistant.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
